case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: All core elements are present: named client & industry, clear cost-reduction mandate, $534K quantified savings with multiple category-level proof points, and detailed approach data.
case_study_packaging.headline: Choice Health At Home unlocks $534K in annualized savings in just five months with Treya’s strategic sourcing program
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Choice Health At Home had expanded rapidly across four states, but purchasing remained decentralized and ad-hoc. Fragmented vendor relationships, inconsistent pricing and limited spend visibility hindered its ability to leverage scale. With Trive Capital and Coltala Holdings looking to accelerate value creation, leadership needed a fast, data-driven procurement strategy to deliver meaningful EBITDA impact before mid-2024.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A multi-state home health and hospice provider had expanded rapidly, but purchasing remained decentralized and ad-hoc. Fragmented vendor relationships, inconsistent pricing and limited spend visibility hindered its ability to leverage scale. With the private equity ownership group focused on operational efficiency and margin improvement, leadership needed a fast, data-driven procurement strategy to deliver meaningful EBITDA impact before mid-2024.
approach_summary: Mapped $17.7M in AP transactions and cleansed vendor data to identify $15.1M of addressable spend across 12 indirect and clinical categories.
Prioritized five high-impact categories representing $6.9M for Wave-1 and launched simultaneous workstreams to meet a five-month timeline.
Renegotiated the incumbent McKesson distribution agreement through market-basket benchmarking and a stepped volume-rebate ladder, capturing 21% savings on medical supplies.
Redesigned Enterprise Fleet Management’s maintenance fee structure, lowering low-mileage rates by up to 48% and delivering a projected $140K annual benefit once the addendum is signed.
Implemented a standardized sourcing toolkit—RFP templates, supplier scorecards and quarterly business reviews—establishing the client’s first enterprise-wide procurement process.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya has validated $534,477 in annual run-rate savings—already generating a 2.1× return on the fixed $250K project fee and exceeding the 1.5× guarantee five months into the engagement. The program is on track to surpass the high-end savings estimate of $1.18M as remaining Fleet and Temp Staffing agreements are finalized. Beyond hard dollars, Choice Health At Home now has a repeatable sourcing framework and real-time visibility into spend performance.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered the first signed contract and savings within 150 days of project kick-off, meeting aggressive PE timelines.
Combined deep healthcare supply-chain expertise with data-driven benchmarking to negotiate 21% reductions while maintaining clinical continuity.
Redesigned cost models (e.g., fleet maintenance buckets) rather than relying solely on price-down tactics, unlocking savings overlooked by internal teams.
Embedded procurement governance—supplier reporting, RFP templates, rebate tracking—equipping the client to sustain savings long after project close.
